class.name: RailVehicleRenderingServer
class.brief_description: Draws rail vehicles: their models, what moves on them, lights, smoke, couplers and detail.
class.description: What a rail vehicle looks like, drawn, keyed by its [RailVehicleServer] handle. The vehicle is drawn at a node ([method vehicle_attach]) - the one its cab, sounds and anything else of the vehicle ride on; the server moves that node wherever [RailVehicleServer] places the vehicle, and draws the models there. Bogies, wheels, pantographs, wipers and mirrors are animated from the vehicle's state natively, once a frame for the vehicles near the camera and a few times a second for the rest.

method.name: builds_get_pending_count
method.description: How many vehicles within the streaming's draw distance still wait for their models to be built. A vehicle's models are built once it stands within the draw distance of the streaming camera, the nearest first, and freed beyond it.

method.name: detection_area_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle a detection area ([PhysicsServer3D]) finds - what a shape cast of the player hits; an empty RID for an area that is no vehicle's.

method.name: vehicle_attach
method.description: The vehicle is drawn in the world of the scene node [param node_id], once it has a place: where [RailVehicleServer] places it on a track, or where [method vehicle_set_transform] says. The node itself is never moved - one that is to follow the vehicle is mounted ([method vehicle_mount_node]). Freed with the vehicle ([signal VehicleServer.vehicle_freed]).

method.name: vehicle_detach
method.description: The vehicle is drawn no more; the models this server built for it are freed.

method.name: vehicle_get_appearance
method.description: What the vehicle looks like, as last set.

method.name: vehicle_get_model
method.description: The exterior model as [E3DRenderingServer] draws it.

method.name: vehicle_get_transform
method.description: Where the vehicle is drawn. The identity for a vehicle not drawn, or without a place yet.

method.name: vehicle_is_detailed
method.description: Whether the vehicle is drawn in detail - as nodes, animated - near the camera.

method.name: vehicle_is_editable
method.description: Whether the vehicle's models stand as nodes the editor shows and edits.

method.name: vehicle_mount_node
method.description: A [Node3D] of another layer rides on the vehicle - a cab, a sound emitter, the node of a vehicle assembled by hand: it is put where the vehicle stands - now, when the vehicle has a place - and wherever the vehicle is placed, until [method vehicle_unmount_node] or the vehicle is freed.

method.name: vehicle_set_appearance
method.description: What the vehicle looks like. With model files this server builds the models itself; without, it draws the ones [method vehicle_set_models] hands it.

method.name: vehicle_set_editable
method.description: Whether the vehicle's models stand as nodes the editor shows and edits ("Edit FIZ"): drawn in detail wherever the camera is, under a holder node of the scene, owned by the scene node's owner. Whoever saves the scene takes them off first.

method.name: vehicle_set_head_display_material
method.description: The material the vehicle's head display is drawn with.

method.name: vehicle_set_load_model
method.description: The cargo, drawn at the floor of the vehicle; none for an empty file name.

method.name: vehicle_set_models
method.description: The exterior and the low-poly interior as [E3DRenderingServer] instances somebody else owns - a vehicle assembled by hand. Announced by [signal vehicle_model_built].

method.name: vehicle_set_transform
method.description: Where a vehicle that stands on no track is drawn - one assembled by hand, where its node stands. [RailVehicleServer]'s placement takes over once the vehicle is on a track. A vehicle's models are in no world until it has a place.

method.name: vehicle_set_visible_low_poly_cabins
method.description: Whether the low-poly interior shows every cab. Not visible - the interior of the occupied cab is drawn in its place by whoever shows it - the low-poly cab of the occupied cab is hidden, or all of them with jointcabs:.

method.name: vehicle_unmount_node
method.description: The node rides on the vehicle no more ([method vehicle_mount_node]); it stays where it is.

signal.name: vehicle_model_built
signal.description: The vehicle's exterior model was built - as nodes near the camera, as RenderingServer instances far from it; what dresses its nodes does it again.
